svg.text: BEST FOR: 8 MATURITY TIERS + 10-STEP BUILD ORDER
FORMAT LINEAGE: Prashant Rathi (#12, 53 likes) & Jonathan Parsons (#10, 71 likes)
The 8-Tier Production AI Maturity Pyramid — and the 10-Step Order to Build It Without Skipping Tiers
Teams fail when they jump straight from Tier 1 (a notebook demo) to Tier 6 (multi-agent swarms) without building Tiers 2-5 first.
Document inputs, edge cases, and failure cost before touching an LLM.
If IF/THEN or regex solves 60% of cases, write Python — not a prompt.
Define strict Pydantic / JSON schemas for inputs and outputs.
You cannot improve what you cannot grade automatically in CI.
Benchmark one well-prompted call before adding chains or loops.
Hybrid search + reranking + deterministic quote-span checks.
Code owns the DAG; LLM handles bounded extraction/drafting nodes.
Mount Top-3 read tools dynamically; enforce loop & token ceilings.
Idempotency keys, taint downgrade, and human sign-off on mutations.
Add subagents & Harness² recursion only when one window saturates.
Recursive skill evolution (Harness²) + automated canary rollback
Git blob SHA evidence receipts + 100% golden trajectory CI gate
Typed blackboard handoffs + gVisor sandbox exit_code == 0 hook
Loop circuit breaker + hard cost ceiling + durable step checkpoints
Top-3 dynamic MCP routing + prompt-injection taint capability downgrade
MCP • AlloyDB pgvector / Qdrant • Model Armor / OPA
Contextual hybrid retrieval + CRAG + 60% window compaction + URI pointers
Vertex RAG / Qdrant • BM25 + Reranker • GCS / MinIO
Pydantic schema enforcement + trace error taxonomy + binary judges
Single raw prompt, static tool dump, happy-path screenshot, zero guards
Raw SDK call • 0 evals • Not production-safe
WHAT BREAKS IF YOU SKIP A TIER
SYMPTOM: Silent prompt regressions on every edit
Without a 50-trace golden eval suite and
Pydantic contracts, fixing bug A quietly breaks
FIX: Build Step 03-04 before adding tools
Dumping 85 tools and raw PDFs into a 200K window
dilutes attention and serves unverified chunks.
FIX: Add Contextual Hybrid RAG + 60% compaction
Giving an unguarded loop write tools lets one
flaky API or poisoned document trigger runaway
FIX: Enforce loop guard, OPA taint, & idempotency
Agents declare victory without running tests and
quote stale architectural facts weeks after code
FIX: Require exit_code==0 & SHA memory receipts
Rule: Earn each tier from the bottom up — never deploy Tier 6 multi-agent autonomy on top of a Tier 1 unverified harness.
